study_identification_part.si_4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two independent Chinese datasets were included: (1) Discovery dataset from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University (105 never-treated first-episode patients with depression and 130 HCs); (2) Replication dataset from the Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (106 patients with depression and 126 HCs). Neither dataset corresponds to a named public dataset from the reference list - they are single-site hospital-based cohorts.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Two independent datasets were included in this study: a discovery dataset and a replication dataset... The discovery dataset included 105 never-treated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."

answer.Discovery dataset (SINGLE-SITE): normative model training and testing for individualized gray matter atrophy assessment

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The discovery dataset was used to train Gaussian process regression normative models on HCs to predict regional GMV from age and sex, then applied to patients to derive individualized Z-scores. The replication dataset was used for external validation to assess reproducibility of main findings.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "All results reported in the main text were based on the discovery dataset and reproduced on the replication dataset... we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients... To assess the reproducibility of our results, the main procedures above were performed on an independent replication dataset."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used Gaussian process regression to build normative models trained on HCs from each dataset separately. For the discovery dataset, 130 HCs were used for training. For the replication dataset, 126 HCs were used. The models were trained on all HCs in each dataset (no explicit train/test split described for the normative model itself - the Z-scores were derived for patients by measuring their deviation from the HC-trained model).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 never-treated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs)... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs... we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics are provided for HCs in each dataset. Discovery dataset HCs (N=130): mean 21.05 years (SD 5.33). Replication dataset HCs (N=126): mean 34.69 years (SD 14.35). No explicit train/test split was described for the normative model, so overall and train phases have the same values. Median, IQR, min, and max are not reported.
